location: inner-city, borders Fitzroy; ~2 km NE of Melbourne CBD
commercial_building_character: Inner-city former industrial suburb now a nightlife/retail and creative-arts hub. Main commercial area is Smith Street (a major retail/nightlife strip); many former warehouses and factories converted into apartments and creative-arts businesses.
verbatim_source_quotes: Its major thoroughfare Smith Street, is one of Melbourne's major nightlife and retail strips, and has been voted the coolest street in the world.
A former industrial suburb, Collingwood is now considered one of Melbourne's gay villages and houses a number of creative arts businesses.
The main commercial area is Smith Street, which borders Fitzroy.
Many of Collingwood's warehouses and factories have been converted into apartments.
